info.title: Skillora API through Phase 4
info.description: Cumulative Laravel REST contract. Embedding registration and offline ML are trusted operator workflows, not public model-training endpoints. Optional learned ranking retains the baseline and current authorization.

post.description: Compatibility account authentication for existing clients. Browser login pages use the fixed professional/employer endpoints. Authentication alone never grants workspace access.

200.description: A 6-digit reset code was emailed because this address belongs to an active account. Unknown addresses receive a validation error and no message.

204.description: Verified reset code consumed; all sessions require reauthentication.
Password changed; all sessions including the current one invalidated.

201.description: Thirty-minute intent bound to this anonymous session.

200.description: Active members can read the organization; only admins receive the members list.

204.description: Admin-authorized change. Last active admin cannot be removed.

201.description: Invitation queued without revealing its bearer token.

get.summary: Read the server-controlled recovery step for this browser. No secret or identity is returned.

post.summary: Verify the reset code for the recovery context held in this browser session.

204.description: Recovery session may choose a password.

post.description: No authenticated login is required. A CSRF-protected first-party session containing the originating recovery context is required; supplied identities cannot create it.

post.summary: Invalidate this browser recovery context when leaving its current step; never grants verification.

204.description: Navigation recorded; abandoned recovery proof is consumed. Login session is unchanged.

post.description: Requires correct credentials and an existing professional identity. The endpoint fixes the required kind. A legitimate dual-identity account may use either portal.

Requires correct credentials and an existing recruiter identity with active membership in an active organization. The endpoint fixes the required kind; submitted role/identity/portal fields cannot grant access.

202.description: Object received; verification queued. Poll the owned upload status until accepted.

200.description: Access-controlled file stream; private files require a current authenticated session.

302.description: Short-lived private storage GET redirect for eligible non-CORS media requests. Never persist the Location.

416.description: Requested video range is not satisfiable.

hiringSkills.description: Skills the organization hires for, strongest first ("Candidates with X").
Skills the organization hires for, strongest first ("Candidates with X").

get.description: Rows for the recruiter's recent job posts, people similar to recent shortlists/conversations/applicants, chosen interest skills and baseline suggestions. section returns one row in full; jobMatches also requires job.
Job seeker people discovery: people you may know (second-degree follows, past co-workers, same city), people with your skills and recent profiles. Excludes you and people you follow.

schema.description: Optional kind:UUID ordering preference. Only current authorized query/filter matches may be promoted; never adds a record. Bound into continuation cursors.

get.description: Exact results and header suggestions retain normal matching and filters. mode=related returns at most 6 separate discovery suggestions, with null total/cursor: shared terms and filters first, then eligible same-category records if no filtered candidates exist. Visibility and role gates never relax. Related mode rejects selected/cursor and limits above 6.

previewUrl.description: Omit to keep the current preview while its URL remains in the body; empty removes it.

patch.description: Set an explicit, idempotent interaction intent for the selected identity. Reposts reference the identity’s own post or work update, or another identity’s currently public accessible source, never a job or a content copy. Reposting never broadens source visibility. enabled=false undoes only the repost.

post.description: Fetches or reuses cached public HTML metadata for an http(s) URL. Private, loopback, link-local, reserved and metadata destinations are rejected (422) before any request; DNS and every redirect (max 3) are revalidated. data is null when the page is unreachable, not HTML or has no metadata. Rate limited per user (429).

get.description: One record per date of the month in Asia/Kolkata. total = sum(days.count); count = sum(activities.count); level thresholds [1,3,6,11]. Months outside range return 422.

delete.description: Deletes every recorded search of the selected workspace.
Deletes the entry and earlier occurrences of the same search.

post.description: "Not interested": removes a visible job, post or update from the workspace's recommendations and main feeds and lowers the weight of its topics and author. Idempotent.

delete.description: Undoes "Not interested". Succeeds when nothing was hidden.

get.description: Recent searches, trending skills (the searcher's first), companies hiring for them and people they may know, each with a reason.

delete.description: Deletes watch history, served lists and search history of every workspace of the account; "Not interested" choices are kept.

get.description: Download (attachment) of the account's recommendation data.

post.description: Records which result was opened from a search on the newest entry for that query from the last day; nothing is stored when search history is off.

session.name: skillora_session
session.description: HTTP-only session; cookie name is environment configurable. Mutations also require trusted Origin and CSRF header.

DeliverySignature.name: X-Delivery-Signature
DeliverySignature.description: Hex HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + period + raw body, using the configured provider callback secret; timestamp must be within five minutes.

ActorContext.name: X-Skillora-User
ActorContext.description: Optional observed-account consistency check. A mismatched authenticated account returns 412; this header never grants access.

Session.description: Safe session snapshot; never includes password, phone, tokens, or security counters.

Challenge.description: Challenge metadata only. Codes last 300 seconds, allow five attempts, and have a 60-second resend cooldown.

Error.description: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 unavailable, 409 conflict, 419 CSRF/session failure, 422 field validation, 429 throttled (Retry-After header), or 500 safe generic failure. All errors include X-Request-ID.

NewPassword.description: 8–128 characters with Argon2id; null characters forbidden. Passwords are never trimmed. Bcrypt deployments additionally require at most 72 UTF-8 bytes.

password.description: Existing passwords do not inherit the current creation minimum.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region. libphonenumber supplies the calling code and validates the national number.

mobile.description: National number digits. libphonenumber validates the length and pattern for the selected region.

pincode.description: India additionally requires exactly six digits, based on the stored intent country.

cover.description: Profile cover image URL; empty when the default banner is shown. Directory and owner views only.
Profile cover image URL; empty when the default banner is shown. Directory and owner views only.

slug.description: Public organization page slug; present when the organization is public.

anyOf.description: Exact units, at most 1000000000000.00; no implicit conversion.
Exact units, at most 1000000000000.00; no implicit conversion.

ranking.description: Best match (sort=relevance under rules-2): structured fit by ApplicantScorer. Shown, never used to hide anyone.

cover.description: Profile cover image URL; empty when the default banner is shown. Directory and owner views only.

hiringMatch.description: Talent search inside an organization (U10): the skills it hires for that this person has. Shown, never used to hide anyone.

cover.description: Profile cover image URL; empty when the default banner is shown. Directory and owner views only.

previewUrl.description: URL from body whose stored server preview should be shown. An unfetched or unavailable URL publishes without a preview.

commentCount.description: Total comments visible to the current viewer, independent of pagination.

cover.description: Profile cover image URL; empty when the default banner is shown. Directory and owner views only.
Profile cover image URL; empty when the default banner is shown. Directory and owner views only.

reason.description: Why this result is shown to this searcher, e.g. "Hiring for React · You follow". Present only when there is a reason.

url.description: Normalized URL from the post text; this is the navigation destination.

anyOf.description: Page-reported canonical URL. Informational only; never used for navigation.

pool.description: Talent pool (E8.f1): the topic this person shares with one of the organization's open jobs.

candidateLimit.description: Candidates the strategy considered: rules-1 the newest 200, rules-2 up to 500 from its candidate sources.

InteractionEvent.description: A passive event from the browser. Likes, saves, follows, applications and hides are recorded by the server.

id.description: Client event id; a retried event is stored once.

dwellMs.description: Required for dwell events and only allowed on them.

requestId.description: Kept only when it is one of the actor's own recommendation lists.

InteractionResult.description: Events about items the actor cannot currently see are dropped, not rejected.

SearchHistoryEntry.description: A submitted search in the selected workspace. Typing suggestions and further result pages are not recorded.

SearchHistoryPage.description: Up to 10 most recent distinct searches, newest first.

MatchBadge.description: How well a person fits a job. Shown, never used to hide anyone.

SearchSuggestions.description: What the search box offers before anything is typed.

SimilarItems.description: Jobs (anyone) or candidates (recruiters) similar to one item: nearest in meaning with embeddings, else most shared skills.

RecommendationQuality.description: Live quality per surface and strategy from first-party served lists; an action counts within windowHours of the first serving of that item to that person.

offline.description: Latest offline accuracy per surface and strategy on held-out recent activity (skillora:evaluate-recommendations / skillora:tune-weights with --store).

PersonalizationSettings.description: Account-wide (both roles). personalize: use my activity to personalise (off: nothing is stored and recommendations use only the profile, follows and "Not interested"). searchHistory: keep my searches.

PersonalizationExport.description: Everything kept for recommendations about the account, and what is inferred from it (F10).

SearchResultOpened.description: A result opened from a search (F4b).

CareerJourneyData.description: Career journey data (memories, colleagues, timeline). Detailed schema: to be completed by the API owner.
